% E2E fixture — narrow-column paragraph wrapping.
% Same body text as paragraph.tex but at \hsize=3in so the line-breaker is
% forced to honour the column width for break selection.
% Before the fix our engine ignored \hsize and produced the fixed wide-column
% break at every width; this fixture pins the width-sensitive break path
% against the MiKTeX baseline regenerated at 3in.
\hsize=3in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\noindent
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The quick brown fox jumps
over the lazy dog. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pack my
box with five dozen liquor jugs.
\par
\bye
